title: Tip: make your phone number easy to call

props.title: Make your phone number easy to call

steps.big: Put it at the top of every page.
steps.small: Customers shouldn't have to scroll to find it.
On a phone, tapping the number should start the call.

steps.big: Test it on your own phone.
steps.small: Open your site and tap the number. It takes ten seconds.

props.outro: We build websites for home service contractors.
